from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial report data regarding employee benefits payable."""
    company_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Name of the company as named in the financial report")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="Stock ticker/symbol if provided, e.g., '002011'")
    employee_benefits_payable_amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="The '应付职工薪酬' amount in CNY")
    reporting_period: Optional[str] = Field(description="The period covered by the report, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_records: List[CompanyFinancialRecord]
